issues.description: `sys` used in cpython/mathimpl.py and np/math/mathimpl.py without an `import sys`.
issues.detail: Both files add `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11):` but the diff shows no `import sys`. If sys isn't already imported, this is a NameError at module load on every Python version. Add the import or use the project's existing `PYVERSION` predicate.

issues.description: Conditional `infer_global` block in mathdecl.py is misplaced and rebinds `Math_unary`.
issues.detail: The `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11):` block sits awkwardly relative to the class body and the line `Math_unary = infer_global(math.exp2)(Math_unary)` reassigns the class name to the decorator's return value. Use a bare statement `infer_global(math.exp2)(Math_unary)` placed cleanly after the class with proper spacing.

issues.description: Inconsistent version-gate idioms across files; use `PYVERSION` everywhere.
issues.detail: mathdecl.py and both mathimpl.py files use raw `sys.version_info >= (3, 11)` while the test uses `numba.core.utils.PYVERSION`. The codebase already standardizes on `PYVERSION`; mixing idioms forces future maintainers to grep two patterns. Pick `PYVERSION` consistently.

issues.description: Test inputs include negative values for unsigned integer types.
issues.detail: `x_values = [-2, -1, -2, 2, 1, 2, .1, .2]` is run through `uint16/uint32/uint64`, with negatives silently wrapping. The list also duplicates `-2` and `2`, looking copy-pasted from `test_exp` without thought. State the input domain per type and add meaningful edge cases (0, inf, nan).

issues.description: Release note RST file is missing a trailing newline and has a malformed underline.
issues.detail: `docs/upcoming_changes/10276.new_feature.rst` ends without a newline and the `------` underline length does not match the title length, which some RST toolchains reject. Add the newline and match the underline length to the title.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on NEEDS-WORK: the feature shape (registering `llvm.exp2` via the existing `unary_math_intr` pattern) is correct and appropriately scoped, but execution has two import-time defects that block merge. `sys` is referenced in two `mathimpl.py` files without an import, and the conditional registration in `mathdecl.py` rebinds the `Math_unary` class name rather than just invoking the decorator. Beyond the P0s, the patch invents three version-gate idioms when `PYVERSION` already exists, the test reuses negative inputs for unsigned types, and the RST release note is malformed. A second pass cleans this up cheaply.
